verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs describe a CLI with a fully headless mode for CI/CD and scripting. The CLI produces processable output, accepts piped input, and has an --auto-approve flag for non-interactive runs. The site also says it runs headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs (all evidence is vendor docs), and documented CI pipeline configuration examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
